checked.summary: Press reports (Voz, Men's Journal) tied the 26 Nov Pennsylvania outages to the Thanksgiving storm, with heavy rain and gusts up to 70 mph downing trees and power lines. No PEMA or utility statement was found; PECO reported over 81,800 out.

BGE said high winds and heavy rain from the Thanksgiving storm brought down trees, poles and wires, with over 105,000 of its customers out at the peak. FOX 5 DC also reported wind gusts toppling trees onto power lines.
